instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: FormSunset Template Recall brief: The objective is to withdraw an outdated document template and activate its replacement after affected business units acknowledge the withdrawal. The Form Owner submits the withdrawal request and identifies the current template and replacement version. The Document Controller records the withdrawal reason and affected category. The Distribution Coordinator records the teams that received the current template. Each Business Unit Custodian acknowledges the withdrawal for their team. The Release Manager activates the replacement only after every identified custodian acknowledges and sends a completion notice to the Form Owner. Template-content redesign and physical printing are outside the project. The category list, affected-team rule, and notice channel are undecided.

output.business_objective: Withdraw an outdated document template and activate its replacement after affected business units acknowledge the withdrawal.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: FormSunset Template Recall manages withdrawal of an outdated template and activation of its replacement. Form Owners identify the current and replacement versions, Document Controllers record withdrawal reasons and categories, Distribution Coordinators identify recipient teams, and Business Unit Custodians acknowledge withdrawal. Release Managers activate replacements only after every identified custodian acknowledges and then notify Form Owners. Content redesign and physical printing are excluded, while the category list, affected-team rule, and notice channel remain unresolved.

Document Controllers and Distribution Coordinators record withdrawal and distribution information, while Business Unit Custodians acknowledge the withdrawal for their teams. Release Managers activate replacements only after all identified custodians acknowledge and then notify Form Owners; content redesign and physical printing are excluded.
